statement: Change a setting, assignment or conversion in point clouds with "Set Attribute"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.
Remove or clear content in point clouds with "Delete"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
Copy content in point clouds with "Duplicate"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy. Variant: operator pointcloud.duplicate.
Copy content in point clouds with "Duplicate"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy. Variant: operator pointcloud.duplicate_move.
Change what is selected in point clouds with "(De)select All"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.
Change what is selected in point clouds with "Select Random"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.

Run the data operation "Separate" on the current selection in point clouds; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.
